title: Grammar of Animacy & The Honorable Harvest
summary: Robin Wall Kimmerer's eco-philosophical framework rooted in the Potawatomi language and traditional ecological knowledge (TEK). In contrast to Indo-European languages where non-human life is relegated to inanimate objects ('it'), the grammar of animacy honors plants, animals, rivers, and mountains as living subjects and elders. This worldview mandates the Honorable Harvest: never take the first, ask permission, take only what is needed, and always give a gift in return.
